Methods note: field-trial aggregation, 1995-2024

Yield responses were pooled across 120 winter-wheat trials. Each degree of seasonal warming above the 26-day optimum coincided with a 6% yield decline.

Adaptation estimates rely on drought-tolerant cultivars rather than shifted sowing dates, and the interval on that decline is wide.
